create_x3d_model: create an X3D video recognition model with configurable width and depth factors for a given number of classes
create_x3d_stem: create an X3D stem layer with depthwise separable convolutions, batch norm, and ReLU activation
create_x3d_bottleneck_block: create an X3D bottleneck block with 1x1x1, 3x3x3 depthwise, and 1x1x1 convolutions plus squeeze-and-excitation
create_x3d_res_block: create an X3D residual block with a bottleneck branch and optional identity shortcut connection
create_x3d_head: create an X3D classification head with projected pooling, dropout, and a linear projection layer
